scoring_justification: Checker directly compares the RDS barriers reported by the agent to the paper gold; no raw DFT output is available for a full recompute. Structural ordering and tolerance-based match are assessed.

outputs.description: Free energy profile for nitrate reduction to ammonia on TiO2(101) and FePc/TiO2(101) at pH 1. Contains one row per intermediate and an 'RDS' row per surface stating the barrier height of the rate-determining step.

steps.description: Check that the reported RDS barriers for TiO2 and FePc/TiO2 are within 0.2 eV of the paper values.
Verify that the FePc/TiO2 RDS barrier is lower than the TiO2 RDS barrier.
